programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: Peter Crouch & Ed Sheeran Discuss Crouchfest, Jay Z AND England’s World Cup 2022 Chances! There's just a month until Crouchfest! Ed Sheeran passes on valuable advice to Peter Crouch, Chris Stark and Statman Dave about how to handle a big crowd as well as discussing England's chances at the World Cup 2022 in Qatar, his best [and worst] ever gigs, being friends with Beyonce and Jay-Z and what he'd put his time into after his music career?! Crouchy gets asked about former team mates and has to pick his favourite England football song. Plus you'll also hear Ed Sheeran discuss the challenges of being a parent and pass judgement on Chris wearing shinpads to 5 a-side!

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: In 'That Contracts Episode' Peter Crouch brings an old contract from his days at Stoke City in the Premier League. You'll learn what clubs do to motivate players, the clauses that are important for footballers and some random stipulations that don't make much sense.

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: Joe Cole joins Peter Crouch and the boys at the pub to tell us how to win an argument with Jose Mourinho, what the worst role in football is and discusses which managers he'd like to take on a lads holiday to Malia.

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: This week, Crouchy, Chris and Sids are joined by Youtube and boxing extraordinaire - KSI!! He sits down with the lads to discuss how his preparations have been going in the lead up to his big fight against pro boxer Tommy Fury - brother of World heavyweight boxing champion Tyson. KSI gives the lads a masterclass in how to make it on YouTube and the mindset needed to handle being one of the most recognisable faces of a generation. KSI and the boys also speak candidly about the dark side of fame and the toll that being in the limelight 24/7 can have upon your mental health. Predictions for the big fight night? KSI reckons it will all be over in 4 - leave your predictions in the comments! Chumbawamba!

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: This week on That Peter Crouch Podcast, Crouchy, Chris and Statman Dave sit down with global superstar Jason Sudeikis, star of Apple TV's Ted Lasso, as they discuss all things football (NOT soccer) related. Jason talks about why he thinks the show has been such such a runaway success on both sides of the pond and also displays some surprisingly impressive footy knowledge. Starky finally finds an ally in the BBQ game and Mike Dean's biggest fan also reveals why he thinks the former ref/chicken slaughterer was born to be in showbusiness. And in a very surprising turn of events, AFC Richmond make a mockery of the transfer windows and make a swoop on one of their biggest players yet....quite literally. Enjoy this and much more only on That Peter Crouch Podcast! Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: After experiencing three loan moves during his career, Crouchy tells us what it's like to be at a club on a temporary basis. You'll learn about conversations between managers and players, how the moves are sold and what happens when your move involves moving to a new country with one friend aged just 18.

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: Ahead of recording in the pub, Aaron agreed to take the podcast team on a tour of the Emirates and surrounding areas. You'll learn which Arsenal legend has set a challenge for one of the current squad, the agenda for the podcast recording and all the best bits of club history around Highbury and Arsenal.

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: On this week’s Friday review podcast, we find out the results of Chris following his heart over his head last week for the Manchester derby (spoiler alert it didn’t pan out) We also hear from the Minister of Mischief who has personally sent us a letter to give us some tantalising hints on how we can supersize this mofo when it comes the lads forfeits - so keep your ideas coming in. Looking ahead to this weekend’s games, the lads throw down their predictions for the Newcastle v Arsenal, Spurs v Chelsea and Burnley v Palace. There are also some honourable shoutouts to the one and only Kanye West and we hear about the time Stoke City signed a fish finger Enjoy!

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: This week on That Peter Crouch Podcast, the boys get deep into the topic of loyalty—and all the chaos that comes with it in football. The lads unpack the messiest transfers, the fan backlash, the manager betrayals, and the true legends who stayed loyal to one badge their whole careers. From personal stories about Crouchy's days at Southampton and Portsmouth, to Sids’ move from Reading to Chelsea, the lads lay it all out: when loyalty means staying, when it means going, and when the fans don’t forgive. Plus, they shout out the proper one-club legends like Maldini, Totti, and Giggs—was their loyalty heroic or career-limiting? You’ll also get outrageous stories about coins passed through the human body, bacon sandwiches thrown in anger, football kits as walking billboards, and a surprise battle of the lawns in suburban Lancashire… Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: At the launch party for the new podcast drink, Peter's wife does his robot dance for the first time ever in front of an audience. They're also treated to a Jennifer Lopez tribute act, a chat with a funeral director and an emotional song paying tribute to Mike Dean.

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: What footballers really think about each other! It's time to take a look at B*tchy Players! It's just a few days until Crouchfest and we've decided to hand this podcast over to you, the listener. It's Peter Crouch's favourite episode of the series as you - the viewers and listeners take control and get to ask a member of the Premier League 100 club anything you like! The main theme is how b*tchy strikers can be about the rest of the squad(!) especially those pesky goalkeepers Rambo! AND Peter Crouch answers questions about making body parts disappear, playing Monopoly and there's a final update on Crouchfest! Crouchy issues a warning for event organisers as well as a serious discussion about when players get 'too comfy' at an elite football club.

programme.title: Abbey Clancy Reveals Peter’s Cheesy Chat Up Lines That Actually Worked!
programme.desc: Love is certainly in the air on today’s episode of the Therapy Crouch, as Abbey and Peter are celebrating all things Valentine’s day. We hear some of their best - and worst - chat up lines used to charm one another and Abbey gives the lowdown on what songs will be making it on to her bonk beats playlist this Wednesday. Abbey and Peter are also on hand to give advice to those of you who are feeling a little bit neglected this time of year as well as what to do if you ever find yourself dating someone whose name gives you the ICK. And fear not singletons, we also have some words of wisdom for those of you who don’t have a date this year and find your legs dangling off the single shelf. Enjoy this week’s Therapy Crouch!

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: After a whirlwind couple of weeks which has seen the lads brushing shoulders with movie stars and legends of the game, Crouchy, Chris and Statman are back in their safe space doing what they do best….chatting sh*t over a couple of cold ones. With a brief cameo from San Marino to check in on Chris’ ball health, Pete also takes a bit of a grilling for his recent #BBQc antics. In Swap Shop, we finally procure a swap worthy of the boots worn by Charlie Adams during last years midges dick challenge - who knew Jose Enrique would be the hero we didn’t think we would all need? The lads also take a look at some of their personal icons of the game with legends like George Best, Maradona and Kerry Dixon all getting honourable shout outs. Enjoy this week’s episode of That Peter Crouch Podcast!

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: Crouchfest 2 is here! Access all areas with Peter Crouch, Chris Stark and Statman Dave at Wembley Arena to experience a night that was scarcely believable! You'll see what happens backstage at Crouchfest and the amazing lineup and crowd who have all signed up to take part without really knowing what to expect! Come inside the dressing room as well as experience the best parts of the show on stage! When an evening! Including performances from Kasabian, Paul Potts, Olly Murs and the finest UK Garage MCs, Joel Stewart's Mike Dean Song, plus David James as a landlord and frequent visits to the Samrat, you never quite know which direction it's going to turn next... Peter, Chris, Dave and the pod team would like to thank everyone who played a role in the event and for everyone who bought tickets to see the show. An unforgettable night like Crouchfest 2 is only possible because of the loyalty and fun that all of you bring. Cheers!

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: With the end of the season looming, Crouchy, Chris and Statman take a minute to look back at some of their biggest hits and misses throughout the past 9 months. We look at some of the runaway successes of the season and some of the more sh*thousery moments (Sam Allardyce comparing himself to Pep springs to mind) We also have a very special voice note from the one and only Jose Enrique who finally puts to bed the one question on everyone’s minds…..if he’s guilty of THAT Gucci slippers purchase And with the season almost at its end, the boys decide its time to put some planning into the coveted That Peter Crouch Podcast Awards night so watch this space. Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: Ahead of last weeks clash of the titans at the Premier League Darts Final, Crouchy, Chris and Statman sit down with some of the legends of the sport to pick their brains on what qualities it takes to become a pro darter in 2023 The lads are joined by Jonny Clayton, Gerwyn Price, Michael van Gerwen and Michael Smith who give insights into their glittering careers and what they are hoping to accomplish over the coming season. They are also on hand to give some top tips to the lads on how to improve their own form, culminating in a nine dart, winner takes all, tournament at the end of the podcast - so watch this space.

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: That Training Session Episode! Who knew that netball, table tennis, water polo and red ar$e would all play an integral part in a Premier League training session?! Peter Crouch details what motivates players, the sessions that footballers hate and how a manager like Rafael Benitez coached teams to play his tactics. Playing true to his selfish-striker mindset, Crouchy raises the issues he has with Erling Haaland and the impact the Norwegian is having on the Premier League and its historic football statistics....

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: Is the number 9 shirt still the most iconic in football? Peter Crouch discusses the return of the position once threatened by extinction thanks to those pesky false 9's at Manchester City and Barcelona! There's a Crouchfest related giveaway and Statman Dave goes through the ups and downs of seeing into the future whilst accepting his performance in fantasy football needs work! Plus Chris Stark has an idea which he believes should grace the stage at Wembley Arena...

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: The pod with no name is back this week with a very special guest….Joleon Lescott! We review how the lads did with their previous score predictions and Joleon is on hand to help Chris avoid making any outrageous shouts such as his triple 3-0 predictions last week. The lads also put down their predictions for some of the big games this weekend, including; Liverpool v Spurs, Everton v Luton and Newcastle v Burnley. The boys have also joined forces with Paddy Power who have given us the odds on some of lads latest predictions and some inspiration for the lads on how they can supercharge the Christmas forfeits.

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: Robson-Kanu on the pod! From youth football rejection to that unforgettable Cruyff turn goal at Euro 2016, Hal opens up about his rollercoaster of a career—one that includes two ACL ruptures, founding a multi-million pound wellness brand, and becoming Wales’ unlikely hero on the global stage. The lads dig deep into Hal’s journey, how his homemade turmeric shots went from his dad’s blender to supermarket shelves, and why inflammation might be the root of most modern-day health issues. There’s talk of brutal Premier League realities, the dressing room dynamics no one sees, and how football still fails players when it comes to mental health. Plus, what it’s really like being a boot boy for the one and only Steve Sidwell, why David Ginola was tight at Christmas, and the story behind how a promised £50-a-goal bonus proved surprisingly lucrative for a young Robson-Kanu.It's a brutally honest, hilarious, and inspiring insight into a career that's anything but ordinary. Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: In this week’s episode of That Peter Crouch Podcast, Pete, Chris and the Notorious S.I.D sit down with Hollywood Superstar Idris Elba to discuss all things Arsenal, rap battles, flight simulators and his new and upcoming Apple TV+ series Hijack.

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: How do you become a professional footballer? In this episode Peter Crouch gives advice to listeners who've reached out, discusses the sacrifices and choices he made as a player and gives you all an insight into the dedication, attitude and mentality required to make it at an elite level. It's That Mentality Episode! There's a discussion about becoming a 'competitive Dad' at a child's sporting event and plenty more!

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: On this week’s episode of That Peter Crouch Podcast, the lads are joined by former Arsenal and Nottingham Forest midfielder Henri Lansbury—a man known for his composed playmaking style, his Premier League journey, and now, his unexpected new life as a lawn-care entrepreneur. Henri gets candid about a life-changing diagnosis—testicular cancer—and opens up on how he discovered it, why he kept it quiet during his career, and how football dressing room culture shaped his response. In a powerful, funny, and refreshingly honest chat, Henri explains the moment he realised something was wrong, the speed of his surgery, and how football banter helped him process it all. The lads also dive into Henri’s career journey through Arsenal’s elite youth system, wild loan spells at Scunthorpe and Norwich, and his glory years at Forest. There’s even time to talk about robot lawn mowers, silent discos, and how Henri went from footballer to founder of Grass Gains, the fertiliser brand making waves in Premier League stadiums and home gardens alike. Stick around to hear some top-class football nostalgia, locker room laughs, and the kind of heartfelt real talk that this podcast delivers best. Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast

KSI gives the lads a masterclass in how to make it on YouTube and the mindset needed to handle being one of the most recognisable faces of a generation. programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast

If you have ever wondered how to smuggle chicken nuggets into an England training camp or how to tell Mr Redknapp himself exactly what you think of him then we have got the podcast for you. Also tune in for updates on Wayne Bridge’s eponymous bridge as well as our hot take on how VAR can be used for the greater good. Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast

Crouchy gets asked about former team mates and has to pick his favourite England football song. Plus you'll also hear Ed Sheeran discuss the challenges of being a parent and pass judgement on Chris wearing shinpads to 5 a-side!

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast

This video; Crouch on the amazing influence of Jamie Carragher at Liverpool, how much he'd love to play in this Liverpool side with Firmino, why Steven Gerrard is the best player Peter Crouch played with, funny messages from Liverpool players on Crouchy's hat-trick ball vs Arsenal, Steven Gerrard the manager, Steven Gerrard the captain and how he arranged the Christmas Party... Steve Finnan, a funny story about Robbie Fowler, how it felt to be dropped for the Champions League final, Rafael Benitez unusual training regime AND playing Red Ar$e with Steven Gerrard!

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast

On this very special episode of That Peter Crouch Podcast, Pete, Chris, and Sids make a pilgrimage to the stately home of none other than Sir Rod Stewart—rock legend, model train aficionado, and die-hard Celtic fan. Recorded inside Rod’s private gym and overlooking his personal football pitch, this episode is a goldmine of outrageous stories and charming confessions. From Elton John gifting him a Rembrandt painting, to the infamous drunken Scottish Cup draw, Rod holds nothing back. He opens up about his lifelong love affair with football, his competitive friendship with Elton, and how his model railway obsession helps him stay grounded (and vocally fit!) while touring the world. Whether he’s reminiscing about pitch invasions at Wembley, revealing the secrets behind his Vegas shows, or naughty 70's antics, this is Rod Stewart at his most raw and relatable. Chumbawamba

In a surprising turn of events, we also hear how the humble roast dinner may have been one of the driving forces behind Reading’s promotion to the premier league and why Chris Stark and Mauricio Pochettino may have more in common than you may initially suspect. And on that note, there is only one thing to leave you all on….. Puddings.Is.Massive.

In Swap Shop, we finally procure a swap worthy of the boots worn by Charlie Adams during last years midges dick challenge - who knew Jose Enrique would be the hero we didn’t think we would all need? The lads also take a look at some of their personal icons of the game with legends like George Best, Maradona and Kerry Dixon all getting honourable shout outs. Enjoy this week’s episode of That Peter Crouch Podcast!

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: Ahead of recording in the pub, Aaron agreed to take the podcast team on a tour of the Emirates and surrounding areas. You'll learn which Arsenal legend has set a challenge for one of the current squad, the agenda for the podcast recording and all the best bits of club history around Highbury and Arsenal.

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: On this week’s Friday review podcast, we find out the results of Chris following his heart over his head last week for the Manchester derby (spoiler alert it didn’t pan out) We also hear from the Minister of Mischief who has personally sent us a letter to give us some tantalising hints on how we can supersize this mofo when it comes the lads forfeits - so keep your ideas coming in. Looking ahead to this weekend’s games, the lads throw down their predictions for the Newcastle v Arsenal, Spurs v Chelsea and Burnley v Palace. There are also some honourable shoutouts to the one and only Kanye West and we hear about the time Stoke City signed a fish finger Enjoy!

programme.title: Harry Redknapp Will Love This!
programme.desc: Peter Crouch & Jermain Defoe! Harry Redknapp's going to love this episode! The podcast reunites one of the Premier League's most iconic duos. Jermain Defoe heads to the pub with Crouchy, Chris Stark and Statman Dave to discuss his relationship with Peter Crouch, when strikers become 'too selfish' and where his obsession with scoring goals came from! There's initial scepticism about the role of stats plus a complaint from friend of the pod Aaron Ramsdale! It's a Jermain Defoe Podcast!

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: This week, Crouch and Chris are joined by the man, the myth, the legend that is Lee Hendrie. The lads discuss some of the changing room antics that went down during their time at the Villa as well as some of their BIG night outs on the town. The lads are also privileged enough to to be given an insight in to some of the more difficult periods in Lee’s life and just how he was able to overcome them. With a career in football that spanned nearly 25 years, it is safe to say Lee has seen more than his fair share both on and off the field with a lot of those antics involving the big man himself. This could be one of our most entertaining guests of the season so far…. Chumbawamba

programme.desc: This week, Crouch and Chris are joined by the man, the myth, the legend that is Lee Hendrie. programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: Joining Chris, Crouchy and Notorious this week, is Tottenham legend and one of Pete’s OG friends in football…..Ledley King! One of the few giants of the game that dedicated their whole professional career to one team, Ledley has seen more than most down the White Hart Lane - having been present for both of the big man’s stints for the North London stalwarts. Ledley also lifts the lid on some of the antics that the lads went through, from England training camps to big nights out with the boys, it’s fair to say Ledley doesn’t pull any punches when it comes to exposing some of Crouchy’s most memorable moments. Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: On this week’s episode of That Peter Crouch Podcast, Crouch and Chris sit down with West Ham legend Julian Dicks to discuss his iconic role in shaping the hammer’s team during his 11 year reign at the club between 88-99. ‘The Terminator’ sheds light on his absolute power penalties, all or nothing winning mentality and aversion to all things flight simulator related (sorry Starky) Outside of football, we also hear what Dicksy would have been if it wasn’t for the beautiful game and how a knee injury almost turned him into the UK’s answer to Tiger Woods. We also FINALLY hear back from our pal Lukas Enrique who goes into detail on that night behind the velvet rope…. Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: In today’s episode of That Peter Crouch Podcast, the lads sit down with the Liverpool, and all round legend that is Jamie Carragher. In this no holds barred chat, the lads talk about their glory days on the red side of merseyside. With insights into some of Pete’s questionable Spanish chat up lines as well Jamie’s peculiar reading habits, it’s safe to say this pod has it all. So, if you have ever found yourself wondering - Is Jamie Carragher parched? What fun could I have with 8 nuns at a wedding? Or where Crouch thinks Carra can stick his champions league medal? Then look no further than That Peter Crouch Podcast! Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: In the first full episode of their new football review podcast, the lads sit down and discuss England’s performance during the international break and get the ball rolling on their new predictions league table. This week, the games that the boys are shining a spotlight on are Wolves v Liverpool, Newcastle v Brentford and West Ham v City. If any of you want to get involved in our weekly tournament then leave your predictions in the comments below and see how you fare against the boys! Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: This week, Crouchy, Chris and Notorious sit down to discuss some of the big money and big name moves to the Middle East and the impact that this may have on the beautiful game. Pete reminisces on a misspent youth spent watching the Serie A highlights on football Italia and reveals some surprising news about his own potential venture into the foreign leagues during his time as a player. The gang also receives one of their favourite ever listener messages relating to a certain Mr Brie and in celebration of Brewdog’s Elvis Juice, our new beer of the month, Pete treats the lads to very special rendition of Suspicious minds……oh yes you read that correctly. Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: In today’s episode of That Peter Crouch Podcast, Pete opens the door on his footballing allegiances which, it is fair to say, have changed slightly throughout the years. Starting off as a staunch ‘Chelsea of old’ fan, the more his glittering career progressed the more bitter his reception at Stamford Bridge became. Join us as we chart Crouchy’s journey through different clubs and gain a better idea on where his allegiances lie now. Chris also sheds light on some slight football sh*thousery he inflicted on his best mate Dougsie during the 2019 FA Cup final which he eloquently tries too pin on the missus. The hunt for a decent swap for Charlie Adams’ coveted boot is also back on, with some hair raising offers been put on the table. That Peter Crouch Podcast - Chumbawamba

programme.title: That Peter Crouch Podcast
programme.desc: Is Anthony Joshua a Watford fan? What do you reckon is the best seat at Leyton Orient's stadium? In this special bonus episode brought you in partnership with Acast and DAZN, the global sports broadcaster, we sit down with Eddie Hearn and Anthony Joshua to talk about the relationship with Boxing and Football and AJ's upcoming fight against Jermaine Franklin on April 1st exclusively on DAZN

programme.title: We’re off to a Rocky Start
programme.desc: In the last episode, Kyle took to the skies; now it’s the seas. Co-host Josh Peterson joins Kyle on a deep sea fishing excursion that ends in one of them losing their lunch.. but who will it be? Later (after everyone’s cleaned up) the gang reconvenes for a legendary course of fire with some serious artillery… and Bob.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 1 - Kicking Off With A Jolt
programme.desc: The first episode of The Big Reveal kicks off with a bang or rather, a jolt, as Compliant Technologies premieres their newest gadget for pioneering the safety of police officers and civilians alike. Next, Kevin Harrington meets with two individuals that Unlock Math for children around the world. Later, Sheriff Mark Lamb sits down with Bonnie from Off Duty Police Officers for a look at her streamlining systems.

programme.title: Three Entrepreneurs Walk Into a Bar...
programme.desc: The Big Reveal does it again by bringing three very different entrepreneurs together, all connected by their pioneer spirit. Flag Guard tips off this episode by explaining how they’re doing their part in keeping your loved ones safe. After that, Dr. West explains how his revolutionary probiotic will fix your digestive health 100% of the time. Host Kevin Harrington then caps off this episode in style with a trip to Tommasina Eyewear’s studio with a peak behind the curtain.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 3 - Grit, Guts, and Game-Changers
programme.desc: Step into the heart of innovation with The Big Reveal! Join Sheriff Mark Lamb and MMA legend Ken Shamrock as they explore groundbreaking American companies revolutionizing their industries. From elite camo designed through deer vision science to lightweight titanium firearm suppressors and EMF-neutralizing tech for peak performance—each story uncovers passion, ingenuity, and grit. Discover what’s shaping America’s entrepreneurial spirit. It’s not just business. It’s The Big Reveal.

programme.desc: The A-Team pushes four companies, GrassTik among them, toward major pivots, sharper positioning and national growth, while Bob Cefail shares the vision behind Boom America.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 4 - Forged in Freedom, Built in America
programme.desc: In this episode of Wild Shots, Tim Harmsen heads to the heart of American gun craftsmanship with an exclusive, behind-the-scenes tour of Palmetto State Armory, where freedom is literally built on the production floor. From the anodizing line to live assembly, Tim witnesses American ingenuity in action as a rifle comes to life before his eyes. With the epic 10,000-Round Challenge complete, it’s time for some serious maintenance. The crew at SEAL 1 steps in with their cutting-edge nanotechnology to give the battle-worn BCM AK the deep clean it deserves. Once the guns are gleaming, it’s time to send rounds downrange. Teaming up with top firearms influencer Sootch, Tim takes aim at a new challenge, including a 1,000-yard Wild Shot that pushes precision, patience, and performance to the limit.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 5 - Microns, Myths, and Machine Guns
programme.desc: This episode of Wildshots kicks off in South Carolina, where Tim Harmsen goes behind the scenes at Jacob Grey Firearms for an inside look at precision craftsmanship in action. Known for their stunning 2011 pistols—true works of art—Jacob Grey takes perfection to the micron. From raw metal to “The Hex,” Tim witnesses how engineering meets artistry to create one of America’s most elite handguns.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 3 - Welcome the Pain
programme.desc: Back by unpopular demand, the infamous “Blah Line” returns—and it’s more brutal than ever. The contestants kick off the day with a hellish PT session that leaves bodies broken and spirits tested. Things only get rougher from there with a punishing stealth crawl over jagged rocks, grinding them down before they face Ken Shamrock’s infamous Lion’s Den training—a relentless gauntlet of pain, grit, and raw endurance. As Don Mann continues to forge a battle-ready team, the squad is thrown into breaching drills designed for high-stakes mission execution. It’s chaos, it’s calculated, and it separates the contenders from the pretenders. In the heat of the action, two standouts emerge from the ranks—earning the coveted role of designated breachers.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 - Ep. 1 - Let The Games Begin
programme.desc: The best of the best are back to compete, and Don’s serving up a heaping plate of his signature 10-part PRT. A bear crawl down a mountain, log running and two-point planks are just some of Don’s welcome gauntlet. And the cherry on top—a 5k desert run. But the contestants only have themselves to blame. Because when you’re already amongst the elite, you have to do whatever it takes to find the one who stands above the rest.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 1 - Skinny Dip in a Snowstorm
programme.desc: Surviving Mann returns with its most punishing season opener yet. In true Don Mann fashion, the bar is raised with a grueling 10-part physical readiness test—infused with a blast of hypothermia for good measure. Don himself calls it “the most brutal PT [he’s] ever witnessed,” and it’s clear the contestants are in for a world of hurt. To push them even further, MMA legend Ken Shamrock joins the fray, bringing his no-nonsense intensity to whip the group into fighting shape. Those who survive the trial by ice and exertion are rewarded with a chance to test-fire the lightest AR on the market—if they can still feel their trigger fingers.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 2 - Welcome to the Lion’s Den
programme.desc: For the first time in Surviving Mann history, the contestants undergo intense combat training led by none other than Ken Shamrock—"the most dangerous man in the world." His relentless situation drills push this elite group beyond their limits, sharpening their instincts and forging next-level tactical readiness. As a new mission begins to take shape, the pressure mounts—and the team learns that the strongest among them will earn a game-changing reward. But in a world where every edge matters, not everyone is built to keep up. Fatigue sets in, tensions rise, and the difference between teammate and competitor begins to blur. With Shamrock watching closely, only the most disciplined will rise to meet the challenge—and prove they’re worthy of what lies ahead.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 - Ep. 1 - Let The Games Begin
programme.desc: The best of the best are back to compete, and Don’s serving up a heaping plate of his signature 10-part PRT. A bear crawl down a mountain, log running and two-point planks are just some of Don’s welcome gauntlet. And the cherry on top—a 5k desert run. But the contestants only have themselves to blame. Because when you’re already amongst the elite, you have to do whatever it takes to find the one who stands above the rest.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 2 - Special Ops Readying For Deployment
programme.desc: The CIA has called again, and Don has answered the call on behalf of the A-team. A team of special operatives are needed for a highly classified peace mission that could turn deadly at a moment's notice. To spearhead their mission training efforts, the team hits the range with some state-of-the-art SIRT pistols. Then, the gloves are off and the team gets their first course of fire for the season. After the fun course of fire, the team switches gears to knife throwing and fire building, with the help of Top Knives. It’s safe to say, these All-stars aren’t waiting a second.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 3 - Catch Me If You Can
programme.desc: It’s a new day, which means Don takes the contestants' training to new heights..literally. But first, the All-Stars are split into teams for a searching mission, using Offgrid’s Faraday bags. Later, they’re introduced to the new ropes course, “The Odyssey”, to test their mental and physical fortitude, as well as their endurance, using a climbing wall. See who rises to the occasion and who suffers from "paralysis by over analysis” in this episode.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 4 - Close The Distance
programme.desc: The day starts off with some unique courses of fire that get the All Stars’ blood pumping. With the help of Rogue Ops, New Frontier Armory and Griffin Armament, the teams are outfitted with the most premiere artillery in the industry. Then, the All Stars get out of the heat and head indoors to do some CQC training with Surviving Mann alum, Randy Couture. If anyone thought it would be a break... they were surely mistaken.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 5 - Let There Be Light
programme.desc: With physical training underway, Don hands the All Stars to master weaponry specialists for intense combat preparation. The contestants face a grueling course of fire with a high-powered rifle, alongside fire-making and blade training challenges. Pushed to their limits, they race to earn points for the upcoming mission, where every skill counts. Can their new tactics withstand Don Mann’s ultimate test of resilience? Watch to find out in Surviving Mann: All Stars.

programme.title: Becoming the Gray Man
programme.desc: The day kicks off with “The 1000-Yard Shot,” and the All-Stars are put to the test bright and early. Who will “make impact” and who will fall flat? Following the competition, Don receives a call from the CIA: the mission is officially greenlit, and it’s time for the All-Stars to kick things into high gear. This moment marks a pivotal shift in their training, with lives now hanging in the balance. After a crash course in the classroom, the All-Stars head to the field for what they think is a land navigation exercise… but things quickly spiral when a group of aggressive hostiles ambushes and captures the competitors for an intense hostage training scenario. Will any of them make it out—and live to tell the tale?

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 7 - No Rest for the Battle-Tested
programme.desc: With a night of torture behind them and a morning packed with PT, the All-Stars set their sights on the mission ahead. When Don introduces a 200-meter shooting evolution using Ace Precision Firearms, the group is eager—though they didn’t expect an air mattress to be part of the equation. Later, Nemo Arms ups the ante with a challenge featuring three of their firearms and a rugged desert terrain course of fire. Just as the contestants begin to wind down for the day, Olight steps in to illuminate the path to the next round of challenges.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 8 - The Best in the West
programme.desc: This morning, the All-Stars are pulled up by their bootstraps to compete for a chance to win The Golden Boy. Who will rise to the occasion in this Western-themed challenge and take home a piece of true American craftsmanship? Next, the training turns cerebral with the help of BlazePod. With mental fortitude playing a critical role in mission success, Don goes above and beyond to ensure the contestants are mentally—and physically—ready for battle. Later, the team is introduced to a groundbreaking product designed to reduce draw time while under enemy fire.

programme.title: We’re Back in Gorge-ous Colorado
programme.desc: Ziplining in Colorado’s Gorges, free falls and donuts. The Real Man show is back in full swing in Colorado. Kyle is joined by special guests and American Patriots as he explores what thrills and adventures this amazing country has to offer. And he’s just getting started.

Later (after everyone’s cleaned up) the gang reconvenes for a legendary course of fire with some serious artillery… and Bob.

programme.desc: The A-Team goes inside Nuethix, Dr. Price’s chiropractic and vitamin operation, Clear Water and Stream2Sea to uncover how each business really works.

programme.title: Boom America S1 Ep. 13 - From Napkin Sketches to Green Frontiers
programme.desc: Four founders bring big ambitions to the A-Team: energy upgrades, no-maintenance privacy fencing, collectible assets, and a title company looking for national reach.

programme.title: Country Ball S1 Ep. 1 - Cole Weightman
programme.desc: Coach Jesse's football docuseries, Country Ball, debuts in Pittsburgh. He guides Cole Weightman, an unrecognized linebacker compared to Steelers' legend Jack Lambert. Will Jesse secure Cole's first offer? Join their premiere's family adventures.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Joe Himon
programme.desc: In Little Rock, Coach Jesse meets gifted Pulaski Academy standout Joe Himon, whose speed, character and courage have yet to bring the recruiting recognition he deserves.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Ryan Nolan
programme.desc: Undersized but talented playmaker Ryan Nolan works with Coach Jesse on strategies to earn scholarship offers, then the two square off in a fastest-shot challenge.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Richard Myers
programme.desc: Indiana lineman Richard Myers has the talent and work ethic for college football but lacks exposure. Coach Jesse talks recruiting strategy between fishing and a demolition derby.

programme.title: Mario Eugenio
programme.desc: Top pass rusher Mario Eugenio faces a painful recruiting reset after injury clouds his Michigan commitment. Coach Jesse helps him navigate the setback and plan what comes next.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Kayleb Wagner
programme.desc: Kayleb Wagner broke Derrick Henry’s Florida high school rushing record, yet an Army offer was withdrawn because he has one arm. Kayleb and his mom, Sam, share his remarkable journey.

programme.title: Luca Stanzani and Dylan Djeté - Part 1
programme.desc: Coach Jesse returns to Clearwater Academy International to spotlight Luca Stanzani and Dylan Djeté, two talented teammates with big football futures and a brother-like bond.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Luca Stanzani and Dylan Djeté - Part 2
programme.desc: The season finale follows Luca and Dylan as their brotherhood and growth come into focus, with Coach Jesse helping them show just how far they’ve come as players.

programme.title: Country Ball 1 - Cole Weightman
programme.desc: Coach Jesse's football docuseries, Country Ball, debuts in Pittsburgh. He guides Cole Weightman, an unrecognized linebacker compared to Steelers' legend Jack Lambert. Will Jesse secure Cole's first offer? Join their premiere's family adventures.

programme.title: Boom America S1 Ep. 13 - From Napkin Sketches to Green Frontiers
programme.desc: Four founders bring big ambitions to the A-Team: energy upgrades, no-maintenance privacy fencing, collectible assets, and a title company looking for national reach.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 1 - Surviving Mann Goes International
programme.desc: A group of 5 All Star contestants were chosen to embark on an adventure overseas, but what they didn’t know is that it would become a maritime mission. Radio Host Kerri Kasem and rockstar Ashba join Don as he breaks the news to the contestants that there’s more to this yacht than a pleasure cruise. If they thought that this trip was going to be smooth sailing, they soon realized how mistaken they were when Don hit them with the hardest physical evolution in Surviving Mann’s history.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 2 - When the CIA Calls…
programme.desc: When the CIA calls, the All-Stars answer. The team is tasked with sabotaging a drug-smuggling boat before it can make its shipment. With mission success hanging in the balance, the All-Stars take their training up a notch, starting with a lesson in maritime navigation. From there, the contestants practice their tactical cast and turtleback swimming, but things take a turn when the contestants partake in a mile race against the current. Who will win and prove their water proficiency?

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 1 Ep. 1 - Survival Of The Toughest
programme.desc: Surviving Mann Season 1 thrilled with challenges, adventure and good old-fashioned American determination. But, before season 2 arrives, we have a new challenge for the best of the best. In All-Stars the top 3 Surviving Mann contestants will face off against 3 special operations veterans in a 48-hour no-sleep battle of endurance and willpower. Starting with a kayak, portage and run challenge, it’s time to discover if these top contestants are worthy of the name All-Stars.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 1 Ep. 2 - Hold The Blah Line
programme.desc: The challenges have only gotten started. In episode two, the two teams must go beyond their limits to come out on top. From the brutal Blah line to chopping down trees with only a small ax, it’s a battle for points that’ll take immense willpower to see to the end.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 3 - The Tides are Changing
programme.desc: After a CIA briefing and punishment for breaking protocol, the contestants get only a brief recovery before facing an afternoon ropes-course gauntlet.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 3 - All About Abs
programme.desc: Matthew and James revisit a punishing day of core work, revealing personal weaknesses, past challenges and what keeps them pushing forward.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 4 - Nothin Better Than Some Shooting and Recon
programme.desc: A nonlethal CO2 weapons course gives the team a new tactical option before their first reconnaissance mission sends them through alligator-filled water toward the rendezvous.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 4 - Nonlethal Weaponry Meets Landnav
programme.desc: Stephen and Zacharias discuss nonlethal weapons and mission prep before U.S. Arms and Athlon Optics preview new gear and the contestants tease a coming surprise.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 5 - Olympic Level PT and an After Action Report
programme.desc: Three-time Olympian Lanny Barnes takes over PT, Mike Glover leads the show’s first after-action report and the dreaded Blah Line makes its season debut.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 5 - So About Last Night..
programme.desc: Chris and Cindy sit down with Jenn and Lanny to take a deep dive into last night’s mission. If it wasn’t difficult enough to do a full day of Surviving Mann training, an overnight mission with no breaks seems to be the cherry on top. After a refreshing 2 hours of sleep, the contestants were back at it with an Olympic-level PT session hosted by Lanny. From there, Jen fills us in on a secret new product in the next episode of Surviving Mann that reminds her of... Fembots? Stay tuned.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 6 - The Range is Hot
programme.desc: The teams hit the range with Black Aces shotguns for a new tactical course of fire, then test a hunting air rifle configured with Athlon Optics and Modern Pneumatic Sporting Devices.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 6 - Faraday Bags and Spicy Buckshot
programme.desc: Kyle and Caleb revisit a brutal hamstring injury before exploring Faraday protection and getting a closer look at Black Aces products and future plans.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 7 - Life Lessons A Plenty
programme.desc: One contestant’s mistake brings punishment for the whole squad, followed by lessons from Don Mann and Mike Glover and a hands-on hollow-point demonstration.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 7 - Hollow Points and the Dreaded Glove
programme.desc: James updates his injury recovery and demonstrates hollow points in gel, Matthew relives The Glove, and BodyHz shares innovations in non-chemical wellness.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 8 - The Glove Returns and It Brought A Friend
programme.desc: The Glove returns to test a new group of contestants before Exothermic Technologies brings an explosive surprise that turns the range into a blast.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 8 - A Walk Down Memory Lane
programme.desc: Stephen and Danny revisit the season’s highs and lows while Compliant Technologies explains the origins of The Glove and Dr. West discusses blood health.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 9 - The W.O.F.T. For The Win
programme.desc: The team travels to W.O.F.T. for elite CQB training with titanium-foam suppressors, then Dr. Jenn previews the next Surviving Mann: All-Stars location.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 9 - The Team Goes To Tactical Paradise
programme.desc: PT gets canceled as the cast heads to W.O.F.T. for intense CQB training, while Jenn and Lanny offer an athlete’s perspective on the elite tactical facility.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 10 - Mission Day and EEIs
programme.desc: Mission day arrives with orders to avoid engaging the cartel while rescuing any hostages they encounter, forcing the team to execute a high-stakes reconnaissance operation.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 10 - Hippo to Hog Hunts
programme.desc: Modern Pneumatic Air Rifles shares an origin story rooted in South African big-game hunting, Athlon Optics explores thermal technology, and the tight leaderboard comes into focus.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 11 - GOAT Rifles for the GOATs
programme.desc: Mission prep pauses for serious firepower, including a full-auto opportunity, a tactical bat with a .22LR pistol, a specialized suppressor and a John Wick shotgun.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 11 - We’ve Got a Movie Star In Our Midst
programme.desc: Chris and Cindy dive into suppressors and a John Wick 4 shotgun with Genesis Arms, then Green Beret Mark Baylis shares how his nonprofit is helping American veterans.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 12 - When Pigtails and Pistols Strike
programme.desc: A planned night mission changes at the last second, forcing the team to adapt to a shifting hostage crisis and send contestants undercover for critical intelligence before the season winner is revealed.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 12 - Dummy Drags and the Ultimate Cheat Code
programme.desc: Danny and Kyle reflect on the competition as the mission nears, including Kyle’s injured-hamstring workaround, while Stream2Sea shares the sun-protection product used by the team.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 1 - Head First into PT
programme.desc: Eight competitors, from Olympic athletes to returning favorites, are thrown straight into PT to determine the new Black and Blue teams and set the tone for Season 3.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: Aftermath 3 Ep. 1 - Here We Go Again
programme.desc: Chris Heaven and three-time Olympian Lanny Barnes break down the brutal opening day, including the contestants' mindset and how Don Mann's training compares with elite athletics.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 1 - Surviving Mann Goes International
programme.desc: A group of 5 All Star contestants were chosen to embark on an adventure overseas, but what they didn’t know is that it would become a maritime mission. If they thought that this trip was going to be smooth sailing, they soon realized how mistaken they were when Don hit them with the hardest physical evolution in Surviving Mann’s history.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 2 - When the CIA Calls…
programme.desc: When the CIA calls, the All-Stars answer. The team is tasked with sabotaging a drug-smuggling boat before it can make its shipment. With mission success hanging in the balance, the All-Stars take their training up a notch, starting with a lesson in maritime navigation. From there, the contestants practice their tactical cast and turtleback swimming, but things take a turn when the contestants partake in a mile race against the current. Who will win and prove their water proficiency?

programme.title: Surviving Mann 1 Ep. 10 - Stronger Today Than Yesterday
programme.desc: Bonus planking shakes up the standings before Don runs a realistic vehicle-ambush drill and champion shooter Renee Enchautegui leads a nighttime shooting challenge.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 3 - Locked and Loaded
programme.desc: It’s go time. The mission day has come and the All-Stars have to rendezvous on a nearby island to pick up their supplies. When it comes to gear, Don pulls out all the stops to ensure mission success. From water jets and state-of-the-art fins to maximize speed, to finding a creative way to keep his team lethally armed without breaking any laws.. Don has a few surprises in store for the All-Stars.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 2 Ep. 4 - It Ain’t Over Yet
programme.desc: With a successful mission under their belts, the team of All-Stars can relax and enjoy a day of diving.. or so they thought. The CIA is calling the team back into action for a VBSS mission to secure deadly poisons that are inbound for civilians. If the team thought the previous mission was challenging, this one makes it look like a cake walk. The All-Stars must call upon all their training thus far to make it through this mission, when an unknown element threatens to jeopardize it and them.

programme.title: Becoming the Gray Man
programme.desc: The day kicks off with “The 1000-Yard Shot,” and the All-Stars are put to the test bright and early. Who will “make impact” and who will fall flat? Following the competition, Don receives a call from the CIA: the mission is officially greenlit, and it’s time for the All-Stars to kick things into high gear. This moment marks a pivotal shift in their training, with lives now hanging in the balance. After a crash course in the classroom, the All-Stars head to the field for what they think is a land navigation exercise… but things quickly spiral when a group of aggressive hostiles ambushes and captures the competitors for an intense hostage training scenario. Will any of them make it out—and live to tell the tale?

programme.title: Battle to the Finals
programme.desc: The pressure peaks as the contestants tackle the final events of the Tactical Decathlon, battling heavy obstacles, precision shooting, exhaustion and injury. After ten grueling events, four earn their place in the finals and make history by completing the first-ever Tactical Decathlon. But just when they think the night is over, Don has one more surprise waiting: a brutal PRT test involving a firehose. The road to the finals isn't over yet.

programme.title: The Ultimate Test
programme.desc: The final four go head-to-head with the championship on the line in the ultimate test of strength, endurance and tactical skill. They'll run, shoot, crawl through mud, battle through fire and push through pain as each fights to prove they have what it takes to become the ultimate champion. Then the worst weather of the competition hits, turning an already brutal finale into a battle against the elements. Four remain. Only one will emerge victorious.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 6 - Blades, Bullets, and Redneck Science
programme.desc: Tim heads to the Smoky Mountains for an action-packed adventure that’s as sharp as it gets. The journey kicks off at the world-famous Smoky Mountain Knife Works, the largest knife store on the planet, where Tim explores the artistry and precision behind the blades of We Knife. There, he reconnects with shooting legend Kyle Lamb, who shares his thoughts on the craftsmanship that keeps professionals equipped for anything. The action continues at Buds Gun Shop, where Tim joins Kyle once again to complete two of Lamb’s signature courses—the intense “Chaos Drill” and the dynamic “Triple Threat.” Together, they test speed, accuracy, and the mental discipline needed to master the range. But the day wouldn’t be complete without a little backwoods ingenuity. IraqVeteran8888 joins Tim for a bit of unconventional fun—combining creativity, curiosity, and some good old Redneck Science to wrap up an unforgettable episode.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 7 - Machines, Mastery, and the Wild Shot King
programme.desc: In this episode of Wildshots, host Tim Harmsen heads to Sig Sauer for an exclusive look inside one of America’s most advanced firearms manufacturing facilities. With a motto of “Every day you wake up and get a little better,” Sig Sauer lives up to its words—producing over 5,000 firearms a day with cutting-edge robotics and precision automation. After a full factory tour, Tim hits Sig’s state-of-the-art testing range to get hands-on with the legendary XM250 machine gun, pushing the limits of modern firepower. Then it’s time for some pure shooting mastery as Tim meets up with friend and firearms influencer 22Plinkster. Known for his unbelievable accuracy and showmanship, 22Plinkster ups the ante—splitting playing cards with a .22 bullet, upside down, and even splitting a single bullet mid-flight to hit two separate targets at once. Finally, the episode caps off with a nod to Hollywood as Tim checks out the Genesis Arms machinery seen in John Wick, blending cinematic cool with real-world firepower.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 1 - Skinny Dip in a Snowstorm
programme.desc: Surviving Mann returns with its most punishing season opener yet. In true Don Mann fashion, the bar is raised with a grueling 10-part physical readiness test—infused with a blast of hypothermia for good measure. Don himself calls it “the most brutal PT [he’s] ever witnessed,” and it’s clear the contestants are in for a world of hurt. To push them even further, MMA legend Ken Shamrock joins the fray, bringing his no-nonsense intensity to whip the group into fighting shape. Those who survive the trial by ice and exertion are rewarded with a chance to test-fire the lightest AR on the market—if they can still feel their trigger fingers.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 2 - Welcome to the Lion’s Den
programme.desc: For the first time in Surviving Mann history, the contestants undergo intense combat training led by none other than Ken Shamrock—"the most dangerous man in the world." His relentless situation drills push this elite group beyond their limits, sharpening their instincts and forging next-level tactical readiness. As a new mission begins to take shape, the pressure mounts—and the team learns that the strongest among them will earn a game-changing reward. But in a world where every edge matters, not everyone is built to keep up. Fatigue sets in, tensions rise, and the difference between teammate and competitor begins to blur. With Shamrock watching closely, only the most disciplined will rise to meet the challenge—and prove they’re worthy of what lies ahead.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 3 - Welcome the Pain
programme.desc: Back by unpopular demand, the infamous “Blah Line” returns—and it’s more brutal than ever. The contestants kick off the day with a hellish PT session that leaves bodies broken and spirits tested. Things only get rougher from there with a punishing stealth crawl over jagged rocks, grinding them down before they face Ken Shamrock’s infamous Lion’s Den training—a relentless gauntlet of pain, grit, and raw endurance. As Don Mann continues to forge a battle-ready team, the squad is thrown into breaching drills designed for high-stakes mission execution. It’s chaos, it’s calculated, and it separates the contenders from the pretenders. In the heat of the action, two standouts emerge from the ranks—earning the coveted role of designated breachers.

programme.title: Surviving Mann 3 Ep. 1 - Head First into PT
programme.desc: Eight competitors, from Olympic athletes to returning favorites, are thrown straight into PT to determine the new Black and Blue teams and set the tone for Season 3.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 - Ep. 9 - Minigun to Mega Chopper
programme.desc: One day before the mission, Capitol Armory brings serious firepower and a helicopter shooting challenge before the team returns to critical final training scenarios.

programme.title: Surviving Mann: All-Stars 3 Ep. 10 - Final Stand
programme.desc: The All-Stars deploy on an executive-protection mission for a key negotiator as escalating terrorist activity turns the operation into a fight to secure their principal and survive.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 4 - Trigger Points
programme.desc: The day begins with a powerful dose of perspective as contestants hear real-life breaching stories from American heroes—reminders of the stakes they’re preparing for. The team is then introduced to a concealed firearm headrest safe designed for rapid-response vehicle defense. Next, it’s straight into the action with a preliminary course of fire using GreenLight sights, where top performers are pushed even further with a bonus round to test speed, accuracy, and composure under pressure. The intensity ramps up during a sentry scenario featuring SABRE CO₂ non-lethal cartridges, putting their stealth and judgment to the test. But just as the dust begins to settle, a new CIA briefing drops—and it’s the most dire yet. With mission reality closing in fast, the contestants close the day with a crash course in S.E.R.E. (Survival, Evasion, Resistance, and Escape) training, rounding out their classroom combat readiness with hard-earned grit.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 5 - No Armor, No Mercy
programme.desc: The stakes continue to climb as Green Light Sights rewards one top shooter with their very own custom weapon—proof that precision pays off. But there's no time to celebrate. Bear Arms ups the ante by issuing defense vests to every contestant, with one hard rule: once it’s on, it stays on. From grueling mission briefings to body armor plank challenges that push endurance to the brink, the weight—literally and mentally—never lets up. Still armored, the team reports to Ken Shamrock for another brutal dose of Lion’s Den physical punishment. Just when they think they’ve caught a break, Compliant Technologies’ infamous glove makes a shocking return to torment a fresh round of contestants. And as the day winds down, Don introduces the team to his personal “Flights” challenge—an unforgiving test no one is excited to take on. It all ends with a sobering CIA reminder: in the field, your backstory might just save your life—or end it.

programme.title: Surviving Mann4 Ep. 6 - The Complete Warrior
programme.desc: This week, memory meets mission as contestants face off in a high-stakes Kim’s Game challenge—designed to sharpen recall under pressure with 100 points and team leadership on the line. With observation, speed, and accuracy all in play, remembering every detail could make or break the mission. As the team pushes forward, it’s time to dig deeper. Contestants open up about their backstories, revealing the powerful personal reasons that brought them to the toughest reality show on earth. Some are here to prove something. Others? To fight for more than just themselves. The action intensifies as Hoffner Knives returns with a brutal tactical evolution, testing shooting and blade skills with precision under pressure. A split-second difference determines the winner of a major reward—proving that in this game, every tenth of a second matters. The day wraps with a visit from HCA Precision Barrels and one final classroom lesson—a pointed reminder that in the world of elite operators, your story is your strength… or your downfall.

programme.title: Beyond The Close 1 Ep. 1 - Tough Times Don't Last, Tough People Do
programme.desc: Ten of the country’s top realtors enter a career-defining competition, guided by an all-star team of business experts as they battle to prove who has what it takes to become number one.

programme.title: Boom America - The Kick-Off Meeting
programme.desc: Kevin Harrington and his A-Team meet Nuethix and Stream2Sea, digging into the growth challenges holding each company back and mapping out their next moves.

programme.title: Boom America S1 Ep. 2 - The A-Team Don’t Pull Punches

programme.title: Kicking Off With A Jolt

Later, Sheriff Mark Lamb sits down with Bonnie from Off Duty Police Officers for a look at her streamlining systems.

programme.title: The Big Reveal 1 Ep. 2 - Three Entrepreneurs Walk Into a Bar...

After that, Dr. West explains how his revolutionary probiotic will fix your digestive health 100% of the time. Host Kevin Harrington then caps off this episode in style with a trip to Tommasina Eyewear’s studio with a peak behind the curtain.

programme.title: Wild Shots S1 Ep. 1 - Liberty Locked & Loaded

From the first colonial settlement to Capitol Hill, he explores the origins of the Second Amendment and the modern fight to protect it. Along the way, he teams up with top firearms experts and puts iconic weapons to the test—including a brutal challenge to see just how many rounds it takes to break an AR-15.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Hunting Stand Ambush - S3E6
programme.desc: Jacob defends his hunting spot from a man trying to steal his ATV. Will his shotgun be effective, or will he need to resort to a backup gun?

programme.title: Gun Talk Nation - NFA Deep Dive: ATF, Suppressor Laws & Wipe Cans - S6E5
programme.desc: Atlas Defense’s Joe Meaux joins Gun Talk Nation to break down NFA law changes, the Jensen ATF ruling, wipe suppressor tech, and the wildest suppressor failures he’s ever seen.

programme.title: Gun Talk Nation - Gunsmith Nightmares & Horror Stories - S6E6
programme.desc: Brownells’ Caleb Savant joins Gun Talk Nation to share gunsmith horror stories, how to find a good gunsmith, DIY tips, and what real craftsmanship actually looks like.

programme.title: Gun Talk Nation - Man Duct Taped on Plane — Full Story - S6E7
programme.desc: Rich O'lenick of Gun For Hire joins Gun Talk Nation to tell the full story behind the viral airplane duct tape incident — mindset, use of force, and plane preparedness tips.

programme.title: Gun Talk Hunt - Cape Buffalo Charge & Hard Cast 9mm Bear Ammo Explained - S6E1
programme.desc: Mike McNett of Double Tap joins Gun Talk Hunt to share a harrowing Cape Buffalo story with his 17-year-old son and break down hard cast bullet science for bear defense.

programme.title: Gun Talk Hunt - Custom Barrels & Suppressor Hosts - S6E2
programme.desc: Austin Orgain of Oklahoma Custom Barrels and Mike Aland of SilencerCo join Gun Talk Hunt to break down barrel quality, suppressor hosts, and building the ultimate hunting rifle.

programme.title: Gun Talk Hunt - Runaway Horse, Ruptured Spleen & Hunting Close Calls - S6E3
programme.desc: Tyler Freel survived a runaway horse, ruptured spleen, and collapsed lung on a mule deer hunt. Adam Weiss adds his own close calls in Gun Talk Hunt’s spooky Halloween series.

programme.title: Gun Talk Hunt - Gators, Grizzlies & Swamp Hunting After Dark - S6E4
programme.desc: Todd Bonura, Tom Stevenson, and KJ share gator hunting close calls, a grizzly bear encounter at dark, and why swamp hunting at night is a different kind of scary on Gun Talk Hunt.

programme.title: Gun Talk Hunt - Lightning, Wolves & Drug Busts in the Dark -S6E5
programme.desc: KJ, game warden Jeremy King, and land agent Thomas Allen share their scariest hunting moments — lightning strikes, a midnight drug bust, and wolves in northern Minnesota.

programme.title: First Person Defender - Backyard Cookout Intruder - S3E7
programme.desc: TJ defends friends and family at a cookout from a knife-wielding robber. Will a hostage deter him from using deadly force?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Assault at the Drug Clinic - S3E8
programme.desc: Christine, a nurse, is leaving work when an armed intruder demands drugs. Does she have the wherewithal to draw from her purse to intervene when the intruder attacks?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Parking Lot Stabbing - S3E9
programme.desc: Jessica witnesses a stabbing in parking lot and intervenes to help the victim. Will she use verbal commands and avoid closing gap too soon?

programme.title: First Person Defender - Gun Fight at the Party - S3E10
programme.desc: Colin is at a party when a guest gets unruly with some female guests. Will he survive the encounter, and how will he deal with multiple assailants?
